title: MERA: A Comprehensive LLM Evaluation in Russian
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The paper mentions 'religion' as a sensitive topic for annotators but does not measure any specific aspect of faith or religion. The ethics and hate speech tasks focus on other social categories like nationality and gender.
findings: Not applicable. The paper does not present any findings related to religion.
